title: The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck in Your Head
hook: That annoying song looping in your head is a brain malfunction.

narration.text: That annoying song looping in your head is a brain malfunction.
It happens when your brain is trying to complete a song.
But it cannot quite recall the full melody or lyrics.
This creates a 'brain itch' that demands resolution.
Your mind then replays the fragment repeatedly, hoping to find the rest.
This often occurs with simple, repetitive tunes you have heard recently.
Sometimes, singing the entire song aloud can finally break the cycle.
What song is stuck in your head right now?

description: Ever wonder why certain songs just won't leave your mind? It is a fascinating quirk of how our brains process and recall music. Learn the surprising reason behind those relentless earworms.
topic: why a song gets stuck in your head and won't leave
